::: {#exm-subgraph}
#### Leaving out a computer

Take the computer $b$ out of the office (@exm-office-graph), with its cables $\set{a, b}$, $\set{b, c}$ and $\set{b, d}$.
What is left is a subgraph (@def-subgraph) of the office graph, with vertex set $\set{a, c, d, e, f}$ and the five edges

$$
\set{a, c}, \set{c, e}, \set{d, e}, \set{d, f}, \set{e, f}.
$$

Taking out $b$ but keeping the edge $\set{b, d}$ would not give a subgraph,
since one endpoint of that edge would not be a vertex.

:::
